title: SS27 Boys' Casualwear Styling
summary: Casual boyswear: stripe tee with denim shorts, polo with chinos, track set for every day, camp shirt over a tee.
research_period: Pitti Bimbo 103, Florence, 24-25 June 2026; Playtime Paris, 28-30 June 2026; analysis July to November 2026
markets: Premium and mid-market childrenswear, Europe-led fairs, global retail

sections.heading: The evidence
sections.body:
- Cozmo showed striped T-shirts and coordinated sets forming a total look, for newborns to 14 years<sup>[1]</sup>
- Sport influence was presented "through a more refined, creative lens"; denim felt "stronger and more diverse than in recent seasons"<sup>[2]</sup>
- MilK's Dressing Idéal chose matching sets by Catimini and Semon ApartMent, a terry top by Piupiuchick, pyjamas by Oda London, a sailor top by Loir Paris, and shoes by Tnin and Affenzahn<sup>[3]</sup>

sections.heading: Formulas
sections.body:
- **Breton tee + denim shorts + canvas shoes.**
- **Polo + chino shorts + sneakers.**
- **Track jacket + matching shorts.**
- **Camp shirt open over a tee.**

design_implications:
- Sets that work as separates.
- Safety: no drawstrings or long cords at the hood, neck or waist, in line with EN 14682; test the attachment strength of buttons, snaps and decorations, and keep small detachable parts off baby and toddler pieces.
